title: Potato purée
notes: Use a floury variety: Agria or Bintje.
Holds in the bowl at 70 °C, butterfly in, for up to 20 min; stir every few minutes (TM7: 5 sec / speed 2, reverse, butterfly). Do not overwork.

steps.text: Pour {water} into the bowl and fill the Varoma with {potato}. Set the Varoma on top and steam until just tender. TM7: 25 min / Varoma / speed 1
Empty the bowl, tip in the potatoes and dry them off. TM7: 1 min / 100 °C / speed 1, reverse
Fit the butterfly and add {salt} and half of {butter}. Mash, then scrape down the bowl. TM7: 15 sec / speed 3, reverse, butterfly
Add the rest of the butter and mix just until smooth. Tiny flecks are fine. TM7: 10 sec / speed 2.5, reverse, butterfly
Add the hot milk a little at a time, mixing after each addition, until silky and slow-flowing. TM7: 10 sec / 70 °C / speed 2, reverse, butterfly
Taste, season with salt and white pepper and serve.
